details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The predicted date, February 12, 2025, contradicts the gold target of 7 August 2026.
details.groundedness_reasoning: 1. Citation [7] describes an Etna eruption with ash and lava, but identifies its timing only as “Monday,” not 7 August 2026. 2. Citation [1] gives a specific date, February 12, 2025, for an eruption, not the gold target date. 3. None of the retrieved citations states or allows derivation of 7 August 2026. The gold target’s specific date is therefore unsupported.
